summary: Map EU AI Act duties to ISO/IEC 42001 controls. Practise AI inventories, impact assessments, and audit evidence. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: AI governance training helps compliance, legal, risk, and technology professionals turn oversight needs into practical records. Participants practise building an AI inventory, classifying systems, assessing impact and risk, mapping controls, reviewing supplier information, and organizing evidence with spreadsheet-based registers. They also draft a management-system scope and audit evidence, then prioritize governance actions in a roadmap for review within their organization.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who classify, oversee, advise on, or govern AI systems under the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001.
modules: EU AI Act and AI Inventory
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with AI systems, compliance, risk management, legal review, or IT governance. Prior ISO/IEC 42001 or EU AI Act awareness is useful but not essential. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as GPAI obligations and conformity assessment are addressed at operational awareness and documentation-review level, not technical implementation level.
